content:
I can read (and usually write) text in **dozens of languages**—roughly **50–100+** to some degree—because I was trained on multilingual data.  

That said, my ability isn’t equal across all of them:
- **Strongest:** English, plus major languages like Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Arabic, Hindi/Urdu, Turkish, etc.
- **Moderate to limited:** many other languages, especially those with less online text or highly specialized vocabulary.
- **Very low-resource languages/dialects:** I may struggle or make mistakes.

If you tell me the language (and what you want to do—read, translate, summarize, explain), I can tell you how well I can handle it.
